text: どくや　やけどで　よわらせても　いいよ！

structure.jp: よわらせても　いいよ！
structure.en: it's fine to weaken it too!

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: よわらせても　いい
patterns.explanation: A て-verb plus も いい says that doing it is okay. よわらせても いい = 'you may weaken it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells you what is used to do the action. どくや やけどで = 'with poison or a burn'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: よわる 'get weak' becomes よわらせる 'make it get weak'. よわらせて = 'weaken it'.
